requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add docker-compose for local environment
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to define the full stack in docker-compose, so that the product can be launched locally with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a developer with Docker installed, When they run docker-compose up, Then all backend and frontend services start successfully and integration tests pass.
Given the services are running, When the health-check endpoint is accessed, Then it returns a healthy status, covered by E2E availability tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time to under 1 minute

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated materials by enabling direct editing
requirements: R1: Add UI controls and API integration to update an existing epidemiological material.
R2: Add UI controls and API integration to delete an existing epidemiological material.

slices.title: Implement material update and delete UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that the knowledge base can be accurately maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user selects to edit it and submits the changes, Then the frontend issues a PUT request and updates the displayed list, validated by component unit tests.
Given an existing material in the catalog, When a user selects to delete it, Then the frontend issues a DELETE request and removes it from the displayed list, validated by integration tests.
Given the material catalog UI, When a user performs edit and delete actions, Then E2E tests successfully verify the complete lifecycle journey.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease time to update or delete a material by 50%

epics.title: Authentication and Session Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents to zero
requirements: R1: Implement authentication and session mechanism to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation.

slices.title: Implement authentication filter for restricted endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to add authentication validation, so that unauthorized users are prompted to log in.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then the system blocks the request and returns an unauthorized status, verified by unit and integration tests.
Given an authenticated user with a valid session, When they access the catalog, Then the system processes the request normally, verified by E2E login and access tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authentication check coverage to 100% of restricted endpoints
